title: SCR-002 Agent Operations: live status, current task, history, errors, tool calls, cost and KPI
risk: Operations cannot see which agents are stuck, what they are doing or what they cost, so a runaway loop or a silent degradation runs unnoticed.
preconditions: Namespace gov-scr-<case_id>-<worker_id>; the operator UI runs against the offline gateway and mock SSE/telemetry streams.
Operator session bound to tenant T1 and an explicit operator_id from fixtures/offline/governance.json; frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z.
One completed run and one degraded agent are seeded for T1 with latency and cost telemetry.

steps.expected: Both agents appear with state, current task, p95 latency, error rate, tool-call count and cost.
MKT-05 is DEGRADED because p95 3100 ms exceeds 2500 ms; the contributing measurement is shown, not just the label.

steps.action: Open the run history entry and its tool-call detail
steps.expected: The run shows its six tool calls, the error-free status, latency and cost recorded from the run row.

steps.action: Verify tenant scoping of the listing
steps.expected: Only T1 agents and runs appear; no T2 row is present in the payload.

assertions: Agent state is derived from the documented thresholds and the derivation is visible to the operator.
Run history, tool-call count, cost and latency come from the run record rather than being recomputed differently on screen.
Zero rows belonging to another tenant appear in the payload.
Cost and latency are displayed with units and are attributable to the specific run.
forbidden: Hardcoding a healthy status while the agent is degraded.
Reporting an aggregate cost that cannot be attributed to a run.
Leaking another tenant's run history into the listing.
evidence: Run detail record with tool calls, latency and cost.
Screenshot of the operations console including the degraded badge.
cleanup: Clear the gov- telemetry keys; seeded agents are restored to the fixture state.
automation: Command Center React components and the gateway routes run as real code under test; ERP, channel and telemetry providers are replaced by the offline mock sinks whose call logs are the oracle. UI assertions use accessible roles and names rather than CSS classes, and stream waits are condition-based.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
